title: Compliance gap analysis
description: Maps current-state evidence against a named policy or standard and creates an owned remediation plan.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: compliance-gap-analysis
  title: Compliance gap analysis
  description: Maps current-state evidence against a named policy or standard and creates an owned remediation plan.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Identify, prioritize, and remediate compliance gaps.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - compliance-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Standard and current-state evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - standard
          - evidence
          - scope
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: requirements
      kind: agent
      name: Parse requirements
      role: Compliance analyst
      prompt: Extract applicable controls, obligations, evidence expectations, and exceptions from the named standard.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: map
      kind: agent
      name: Map evidence to controls
      role: Compliance assessor
      prompt: Mark each control compliant, partially compliant, noncompliant, or not applicable with evidence citations.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: plan
      kind: agent
      name: Build remediation plan
      role: Compliance program manager
      prompt: Prioritize gaps by risk and assign owners, corrective actions, milestones, and required evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: compliance-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Compliance owner approves gap register
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Compliance gap matrix and remediation roadmap
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: requirements
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: requirements
      to: map
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: map
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: map
      to: plan
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: plan
      to: compliance-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e6
      from: compliance-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
